meta.title: 手机摄影｜6种电影运镜，vlog新手必学
meta.title_en: Phone Filmmaking: 6 Cinematic Camera Moves Beginners Must Learn

scenes.context: 拿着稳定器向前走的同时推动摇杆，一个镜头包含前推和上摇两个运动。
sentences: 今天我会用手机和云台教大家几种电影中常见的运镜方式。
Today I'll teach several common cinematic camera moves using a phone and gimbal.
camera moves（运镜方式）
第一个是前推加上摇镜头。
The first is a push-in combined with an upward tilt.
push-in and tilt（前推加摇）
在拿着稳定器向前走的过程中，同时用手指往上推动摇杆。
Walk forward with the gimbal while pushing the joystick up.
joystick（摇杆）
因为一个镜头中包含了前推和向上摇两个运动，画面整体会变得十分动感。
With both motions in one shot, the frame becomes very dynamic.
dynamic（动感）
scenes.speak: Today I'll teach several common cinematic camera moves using a phone and gimbal. The first is a push-in combined with an upward tilt. Walk forward with the gimbal while pushing the joystick up. With both motions in one shot, the frame becomes very dynamic.

scenes.context: 利用稳定器延长杆翻转云台拍摄，配合前景才能产生有层次的画面。
sentences: 第二个是横移镜头。
The second is the lateral tracking move.
lateral move（横移）
利用稳定器自带的延长杆，翻转云台进行拍摄。
Use the built-in extension rod and flip the gimbal to shoot.
extension rod（延长杆）
这里一定要注意配合上前景，才能产生有层次的画面。
You must include a foreground for layered frames.
foreground（前景）
横移镜头在电影中经常出现，跟随人物进行左右之间的移动。
Lateral moves appear often in films, following characters left and right.
follow the character（跟随人物）
scenes.speak: The second is the lateral tracking move. Use the built-in extension rod and flip the gimbal to shoot. You must include a foreground for layered frames. Lateral moves appear often in films, following characters left and right.

scenes.context: 围绕主体拍摄，半蹲前进能带来更稳定的画面。
sentences: 第三个是环绕镜头，围绕主体进行拍摄。
Third is the orbit shot, circling the subject.
orbit shot（环绕镜头）
大家可以看到我的脚步其实是半蹲前进的状态。
You can see my steps are a half-crouch walk.
half-crouch（半蹲）
这样半蹲的前进能够给到我们更稳定的画面。
A half-crouch walk gives a steadier frame.
steadier frame（更稳定）
在拍摄过程中，云台始终围绕主体进行拍摄。
Throughout, the gimbal keeps circling the subject.
keep circling（始终环绕）
scenes.speak: Third is the orbit shot, circling the subject. You can see my steps are a half-crouch walk. A half-crouch walk gives a steadier frame. Throughout, the gimbal keeps circling the subject.

scenes.context: 前推镜头简单但用法多，人物伤感或思考时导演常用缓慢前推增强情绪。
sentences: 第四个是前推镜头，非常简单，但是用法却非常多。
Fourth is the push-in—simple but endlessly useful.
push-in（前推）
它可以是快速的向前推进，也可以是缓慢的向前推进。
It can be a fast push or a slow one.
fast or slow（快慢皆可）
电影中经常会出现人物伤感或者思考的时刻。
Films often show characters feeling sad or lost in thought.
sad or thinking（伤感或思考）
一般导演都会用缓慢前推，去进行人物情绪的增强。
Directors usually push in slowly to heighten the emotion.
heighten emotion（增强情绪）
scenes.speak: Fourth is the push-in—simple but endlessly useful. It can be a fast push or a slow one. Films often show characters feeling sad or lost in thought. Directors usually push in slowly to heighten the emotion.

scenes.context: 完全蹲下后用脚和身体同时提升，画面更平稳；缓慢上升常用于揭露隐藏画面。
sentences: 第五个是上升镜头，这里有一个使用稳定器的技巧。
Fifth is the rising shot—here's a gimbal trick.
rising shot（上升镜头）
一般我会完全蹲下，然后运用脚和身体同时往上提升。
I usually squat fully, then rise with legs and body together.
squat and rise（蹲下提升）
这样的画面出来更加平稳。
The result is a much steadier shot.
steadier（更平稳）
缓慢的镜头上升一般在电影中用作画面遮罩，揭露隐藏画面。
A slow rise often acts as a mask, revealing hidden content.
reveal hidden content（揭露隐藏画面）
scenes.speak: Fifth is the rising shot—here's a gimbal trick. I usually squat fully, then rise with legs and body together. The result is a much steadier shot. A slow rise often acts as a mask, revealing hidden content.

scenes.context: 通过横移镜头运动，在两个视觉焦点之间进行切换。
sentences: 最后一个镜头是横移焦点转换镜头。
The last one is a lateral move that shifts focus.
focus shift（焦点转换）
这个镜头的意思是通过横移的镜头运动，在两个视觉焦点之间进行切换。
It shifts between two visual focal points through a lateral motion.
two focal points（两个焦点）
第一个我们的焦点在这个陶瓷人脸上。
First, the focus is on the ceramic face.
ceramic face（陶瓷人像）
然后通过横移，把焦点切换到后面的雕塑上。
Then the lateral move shifts focus to the sculpture behind.
shift to the sculpture（切到雕塑）
scenes.speak: The last one is a lateral move that shifts focus. It shifts between two visual focal points through a lateral motion. First, the focus is on the ceramic face. Then the lateral move shifts focus to the sculpture behind.

practice: Push-in plus upward tilt makes one dynamic shot.
Lateral moves need a foreground for layers.
Slow push-ins heighten sad or thinking moments.
A slow rise reveals hidden content.
pitfalls: Push plus tilt gives one dynamic frame.
Slow rises mask and reveal content.
shifts: 说运镜只会说 camera move
用 push-in（前推）、lateral move（横移）、orbit shot（环绕）、rising shot（上升）
用 joystick（摇杆）、extension rod（延长杆）、half-crouch walk（半蹲前进）
用 heighten emotion（增强情绪）、reveal hidden content（揭露隐藏画面）、focus shift（焦点转换）
